text: Al Salam Bank is a public bank listed on Bahrain Bourse; its major shareholders at 31 December 2025 were Bank Muscat S.A.O.G. (14.74%), Muscat Overseas Company L.L.C. (8.43%), both of Oman, and Sayacorp B.S.C. Closed (6.28%) of Bahrain. Its chairman, Shaikh Khalid bin Mustahail Al Mashani, is also chairman of Bank Muscat.
short: Al Salam Bank is a listed Bahraini bank; largest holder Bank Muscat at 14.74%
